text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"35 (-0.007/-0.2)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N7","page":1,"quote":"FINISH & DEPTH : FERRINOX , DEPTH 0.2 TO 0.3 MM"}],"comment":"The main shaft diameter (D7) has a tolerance band of 0.193 mm, but the Ferrinox surface treatment (N7) adds 0.2–0.3 mm per side (0.4–0.6 mm on diameter), which will push the finished part well outside its specified limits and prevent proper assembly. The designer must either increase the pre-coating machining undersize to account for the coating thickness or specify that the diameter is to be machined after coating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying the pre-coating size adjusted for the Ferrinox depth, or require final machining after surface treatment."}]}
